items.summary: CRO handoff: retain the repository and market-signal opportunities as deferred research backlog only. MarkItDown could support source-to-draft SEO workflows; Mermaid could add explainers and comparison diagrams; shadcn/ui could standardize accessible CTA and affiliate-card patterns. Evidence is limited to bounded lab review: MarkItDown and shadcn/ui passed available checks, while Mermaid had supported fit but no native checks. MIT/Apache-2.0 signals do not replace dependency, security, maintenance, content-rights, or production-fit review; MinerU and Strapi remain license/fit unknown from NOASSERTION. Smallest reversible prototypes would be isolated offline samples or static mock components, with metrics limited to drafting time, publishing throughput, CTA engagement, and search clicks after existing gates clear. Do not dispatch prototypes, install dependencies, deploy, add telemetry, spend, or claim revenue or causal lift this cycle.

CRO handoff: preserve the strongest revenue experiments as deferred opportunities rather than new work. The allthingsmasonic.com affiliate path has 61 clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission in the available window; amputeenews.com still has a real Amazon tag prerequisite; aggregate provider earnings remain unattributed. Candidate experiments are CTA/disclosure clarity, product relevance, and intent-matched comparison content, measured only with existing attribution and rollback controls. Retain unknown revenue, do not infer ROI, and do not create duplicate requests while current measurement, failure-repair, security, ownership, and attribution work remains open.

CRO handoff: preserve SEO and audience experiments as a ranked deferred backlog. Evidence-backed candidates include xxxtea.com query cannibalization, saveusfarms.com title/CTR improvement, broadwayshowgirls.com author-page CTR, marineactivity.com AIS guide reach, deeppenetrations.com review-page CTR, and greatamericanlakes.com topic-page reach. Each should use a single reversible edit, existing GA4/GSC measurement, a pre-change baseline, a defined learning window, and rollback. Current active work, failed requests, unavailable operations evidence, and measurement backlog block new dispatch this cycle.
